# The merry-go-round

<!-- STEP id="arc" -->
A child sits on a moving merry-go-round and goes from A to B to C. The distance travelled is the curve ABC. The displacement is the straight line AC. They are not equal.

<!-- STEP id="round" -->
In one full round, the distance travelled is the circumference, 2πR. The displacement is zero, because the child is back at the start.

If one round takes a time T, the average speed is 2πR / T. The average velocity over the round is zero.
